title: Session
description: A short-lived working context bound to its issuing Principal by a REQUIRED ed25519 signature over the session claims. A session without the signed principal link is invalid.

principal_id.description: principal_id of the Principal that issued (and signed) this session.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the session was issued.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp after which the session MUST be treated as invalid.

principal_signature.description: 64-byte ed25519 signature by the issuing Principal over the canonical session claims (session_id, principal_id, issued_at, expires_at), standard base64 with padding (exactly 88 characters).

extensions.description: Open bag for vendor or profile extensions. Keys SHOULD be namespaced (e.g. 'vendor.example/field').
